compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Directors must report breaches, discrepancies or irregularities to the Controlling Body within 24 hours if not rectified by the Participant; a bi-annual signed report detailing material problems and their resolutions is also required.
Relevant Regulatory Basis: Strate Rules 8.3.2.2, 8.3.2.3, and 8.3.2.5 as stated in the regulatory context provided from [Source 1].
Explanation: The Participant has a duty to report any breaches or irregularities within specified timeframes (24 hours) if unrectified by them; otherwise, it falls on their directors or compliance officer to make this report. Additionally, the bi-annual reporting requirement mandates that material issues encountered in the past six months be documented and addressed accordingly as part of continuous monitoring obligations under Strate Rules 8.3.2.5.
